catalog_rule_object_shape_check.name: catalog_rule_object_shape_check
catalog_rule_object_shape_check.value: ("catalog_rule"."rule_type" = 'requires_capability' AND "catalog_rule"."capability_id" IS NOT NULL AND "catalog_rule"."object_add_on_id" IS NULL) OR ("catalog_rule"."rule_type" <> 'requires_capability' AND "catalog_rule"."capability_id" IS NULL AND "catalog_rule"."object_add_on_id" IS NOT NULL)

catalog_rule_no_self_pair_check.name: catalog_rule_no_self_pair_check
catalog_rule_no_self_pair_check.value: "catalog_rule"."subject_add_on_id" IS NULL OR "catalog_rule"."object_add_on_id" IS NULL OR "catalog_rule"."subject_add_on_id" <> "catalog_rule"."object_add_on_id"

onboarding_site_media_upload_lease_check.name: onboarding_site_media_upload_lease_check
onboarding_site_media_upload_lease_check.value: ("onboarding_site_media"."claim_status" = 'uploading' AND "onboarding_site_media"."upload_lease_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("onboarding_site_media"."claim_status" <> 'uploading' AND "onboarding_site_media"."upload_lease_id" IS NULL)

onboarding_site_media_dimensions_check.name: onboarding_site_media_dimensions_check
onboarding_site_media_dimensions_check.value: ("onboarding_site_media"."width" IS NULL OR "onboarding_site_media"."width" > 0) AND ("onboarding_site_media"."height" IS NULL OR "onboarding_site_media"."height" > 0)

onboarding_site_media_ready_storage_chec.name: onboarding_site_media_ready_storage_check
onboarding_site_media_ready_storage_chec.value: "onboarding_site_media"."claim_status" <> 'ready' OR ("onboarding_site_media"."storage_provider" IS NOT NULL AND "onboarding_site_media"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL)

salon_signup_invite_active_salon_idx.name: salon_signup_invite_active_salon_idx

salon_signup_invite_active_email_idx.name: salon_signup_invite_active_email_idx
salon_signup_invite_active_email_idx.where: "salon_signup_invite"."intent" = 'create_salon' and "salon_signup_invite"."consumed_at" is null and "salon_signup_invite"."revoked_at" is null
